allowed-base-images.weakness_name: Base image not restricted to an approved allow list
allowed-base-images.weakness_description: Containers may run base images outside the cluster-wide approved allow list, weakening supply-chain assurance for CM-2 (Baseline Configuration).
allowed-base-images.remediation_plan: Define a cluster-wide allowed base image list and enforce it with the Kyverno allowed-base-images policy; add the OCI base annotation to all build pipelines.

milestones.description: Enforce Kyverno allowed-base-images policy in audit->enforce

policy-high-scan.weakness_description: The cluster scan profile does not run at the high level required by policy for CM-6 (Configuration Settings).
policy-high-scan.remediation_plan: Set the scan profile to high and schedule recurring high-level scans; wire results into the compliance pipeline.

policy-disallowed-roles.weakness_description: RoleBindings grant roles outside the allowed set, violating AC-1 (Policy and Procedures) least-privilege expectations.
policy-disallowed-roles.remediation_plan: Remove disallowed RoleBindings; enforce the OCM policy-disallowed-roles policy to prevent recurrence.

disallow-capabilities.weakness_description: Containers could add Linux capabilities beyond the policy allow list (CM-2.1).
disallow-capabilities.remediation_plan: Enforce the Kyverno disallow-capabilities policy across all namespaces.

policy-deployment.weakness_description: NGINX deployment could fall below the configured minimum replica count (CM-2).
policy-deployment.remediation_plan: Enforce the OCM policy-deployment minimum-replica policy.

demo_examples.checks.test_github.GitHubO.weakness_name: GitHub API version may be unsupported
demo_examples.checks.test_github.GitHubO.weakness_description: The GitHub API might not return a supported version (CM-2).
demo_examples.checks.test_github.GitHubO.remediation_plan: Monitor GitHub API version via Auditree; upgrade integrations before deprecation.

demo_examples.checks.test_github.GitHubO.weakness_description: The GitHub org might have no members (AC-2, Account Management).
demo_examples.checks.test_github.GitHubO.remediation_plan: Alert via Auditree if the GitHub org membership drops to zero.
